component.name: GeoSpaX
component.summary: Open-source GIS where maps make themselves

description.p: GeoSpaX is for people who want a finished map without spending hours on it. Drop in data, or plug in a phone, GPS, drone card, camera or sensor logger, and GeoSpaX styles it, lays out the map, writes the report and exports PNG, PDF and SVG. When you want control, a full workbench is one click away.

ul.li: Two modes: Lazy, with plain-language next steps, and Pro, with a ribbon, layer tree, attribute table and editing
Maps that style themselves, and full symbology for points, lines, polygons, labels and rasters
About 1,130 analysis tools: vector, raster, terrain, hydrology, imagery, LiDAR, hot spots and kriging
Twelve domain plugins: agriculture, biodiversity, climate, conservation, forestry, marine, soil and more
Online data cut to your area with citations: WorldClim, SoilGrids, GBIF, OBIS, GADM, Copernicus DEM, GEBCO
Design and CAD with snapping, dimensions and DXF to and from AutoCAD
Re-runnable recipes with triggers, R and Python steps, and an AI assistant

description.p: Everything runs on your computer and works offline.

screenshot.caption: The Pro workbench: buildings, roads and places of Lae with street names over satellite imagery
Lazy mode: layer cards, a task bar and next steps
Design: a 76-lot subdivision plan with roads and dimensions
Hydrology: streams by Strahler order and drainage basins
LiDAR buildings raised to their roof heights in 3D

description.p: Ten industry plugins (surveying, energy, oil and gas, mining, maritime, aeronautical, transport, urban and rural planning, asset management) and twelve kits; ENSO and El Niño climate tools; an illustrated user guide; steadier swipe and spyglass.

Fixes: the phone page of the web edition sends positions again, the 3D terrain viewer opens inside the app again, analysis rasters draw under the points and contours of their map, and the Imagery tab lists the wetness index once.

The ribbon tools tab by tab (zonal statistics, topology checks, editing tools, swipe, time slider, web map export, tutorials); rate limits and a content security policy for the web demo; steadier GPS positions in GeoSpaX Field.
Security fixes for the public web demo: visitors kept apart, upload limits.
Public guest demo of the web app, redesigned side panels, a ribbon in the order of the work.

ul.li: Fixed: the desktop app could not get online data, save recipes or run plugin tools ("Failed to fetch")
Fixed: weighted suitability scored higher-is-better criteria the wrong way round
New: the app tells you when a new version is out
